subject: Post-call: Finovate discovery + proposed demo cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovate.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@finovate.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Quick recap + next step: technical deep dive scheduling

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap of the discovery points we covered: 
- Primary use case: real-time customer support triage (high concurrency, short responses).
- Key constraints: PII controls, on-prem option for audit logs, predictable 99th percentile latency targets.
- Success metric for pilot: ~50ms median token latency for common flows and <=0.5 USD/1k tokens target for cost.

Next step: technical deep dive + demo focused on throughput and observability (45 minutes). We want to include your engineering lead and our infra/product folks.

Because your users are global, you mentioned the team spans US, EU and APAC time zones. To avoid forcing a single inconvenient slot repeatedly, I propose we pilot a rotating "office-hours" cadence so different regions get a friendly hour every other week. Below are three proposed slots (I included time-zone conversions):

Option A (Americas-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / Wed 02:00 SGT (APAC)
Option B (EMEA overlap): Wed 16:00 CET / 15:00 UK / 10:00 ET
Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 SGT / Wed 21:00 PT / Thu 00:00 ET

Please indicate preferred option and who from your side will join the technical run-through (names + roles). I cc'd Laura (solutions engineer) and Ava (platform PM) who will lead the demo.

Attached: one-pager mutual action plan + proposed demo TOC.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-demo-TOC.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovate.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@finovate.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: technical deep dive scheduling

Thanks, Jonas — really helpful summary. Quick answers from our side:
- We'll want our infra lead (Priya Ramesh, priya.r@finovate.com) and engineering manager (Tom, cc'd) on the call.
- Rotating office-hours sounds reasonable. If we have to pick one option for the first run, Option B (EMEA overlap) works best for our HQ folks in London; it also catches late-morning ET.
- For recurring cadence: monthly with the option to add extra region-specific deep dives later.

One ask: can you propose two consecutive demo dates for Option B next week and include calendar invites? Helps us lock down approvals quickly.

Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, Finovate
